import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acc = df[df.account_id=='e0yOWue'].copy()
dims = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

comp = pd.concat([b,g],axis=1)

# threshold: > 3*median absolute delta of nonzero? use std
nz = comp[comp.delta!=0].delta
print("n nonzero:", len(nz), "std:", nz.std(), "mean abs:", nz.abs().mean())
top = comp[comp.delta > 3*nz.std()]
print(top)
# check each top resource's daily series: was it normal before?
for idx in top.index:
    c,csv,app,fam = idx
    s = acc[(acc.csp==c)&(acc.cloud_service==csv)&(acc.application==app)&(acc.instance_family==fam)]
    print(idx, s.num_instances.tolist())
